audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Wukong, Wukong, Wukong, Skill, Wukong, Skill, Wukong on both layers, giving Wukong Level 6 and the 2-item row in a matchup the page itself calls a hard scaling loss. diff was the enum 'HARD' next to a 4/10 rating and a green tone.
audit.why: The mirror (kayle__wukong) already fixed this chart to Wukong, Wukong, Wukong, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, and this page's own whys[3..6] all say Kayle. Restating the mirror rather than re-deriving it.
audit.corrected: Rows 4-7 flipped to Kayle as matched pairs on both layers with ratings following; diff set to FAV to agree with 4/10, the green tone and the 53.6% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].why sold Level 6, Black Cleaver and the 2-item window as Wukong spikes.
audit.why: Level 6 is Divine Judgment; first item is her ranged form; two items is where she leaves you behind. Divine Ascent grants attack range as she levels — the melee window closes on a level timer, not an item timer.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].why rewritten to her spikes: Radiant Blast's resistance shred, the 160s ult, the arrival of range, and 'the game should be over by now'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment was described only as 'her get-out at 6' with no cooldown, and phases[4].why claimed Cyclone's knockup 'wins every committed brawl' at 6.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s — the longest cooldown in the lane, and the rank-1 160s is what makes baiting it a real, nearly three-minute window. It makes the target invulnerable, so a committed Cyclone into an unspent ult simply does nothing. Radiant Blast (12s rank 1, 900 range) reduces resistances, which is why her follow-up hurts more than the poke looks. Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal — the actual target for Executioner's Calling.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, phases[4].why and breakdown.late all carry the real numbers now.

audit.why: The page had no numbers at all.
audit.corrected: Concrete waits added: bait the 160s ult, engage into a spent Radiant Blast (12s), anti-heal her 15s Celestial Blessing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said Executioner's Calling early because 'his healing fights your pattern' — wrong pronoun and no named source.
audit.why: The healing is Celestial Blessing (W), a flat 15s cooldown, so the anti-heal call is correct but was unattributed.
